content.comment_body: Hello everyone! I am using this [product_name] PLC with reference [article_no]. How can I tell if it is [article_no].Standard, [article_no].Standard, [product_name].[version_no] or another type? Is there any [document] that covers general identification? Thanks.

It is definitely a [article_no] and not a [article_no]. Whether it is a [article_no].Standard or a [product_name].[version_no] can only be determined by checking the FS version or the firmware version.

analysis.insight_summary: The user seeks guidance on how to identify specific hardware versions of a [product_name] module, including different model and firmware versions. Community responses indicate it is challenging to determine the exact version from the reference alone and highlight a lack of clear documentation for this purpose. This points to a common issue among users regarding hardware differentiation and the need for better versioning information.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects documentation and clear procedures to be available and accessible, making it easy to identify precise hardware and firmware versions of [product_name] modules.
